svg.title: Hello FPGA Kit to 6x TMC5160 direct wiring (stage 1, Rev. D)
svg.text: SmartManipulator-X — Hello FPGA Kit → 6× TMC5160 direct wiring (stage 1, SPI only)
Source: Wiring_RevD_DirectWiring_EN (draft Rev. D, 2026-10-07, for review – not released). Logic wires: Dupont m/f ≤ 30 cm, 3.3 V levels only.
PC side 460800 bps · to SF2 230400 bps
SPI mode 3, ≤ 2 MHz · SDO is high-Z while CSN is high, so MISO is shared · never route VM or motor phases over Dupont/breadboard · never plug motors while powered
